All checks pass now: JSON valid, no broken symlinks, every plugin folder name matches its `plugin.json` name, every SKILL.md/subagent has `name`+`description`, every skill/agent has both a `.claude/skills|agents` link and a README row, and the only real folders left in `.claude/skills/` are the four exempt third-party ones (untouched).

|---|---|

| `plugins/avatar-video/.../plugin.json` had no `description` | Added `"description": "The avatar-video plugin."` |
| `plugins/outlook-email/.../plugin.json` had no `version` | Added `"version": "0.1.0"` |
